name: SQL Injection (error-based)
grep: Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server
Unclosed quotation mark after the character string
detail: A database error was triggered by injecting SQL metacharacters, indicating the parameter is concatenated into a SQL query.

name: SQL Injection (time-based blind)
detail: Injecting a database sleep caused the response to be delayed by ~5 seconds, indicating blind SQL injection.

name: SQL Injection (boolean-based blind)
detail: A true vs false SQL condition produced different responses, indicating boolean-based blind SQL injection.

name: Path Traversal
detail: The response contained the contents of a system file, indicating the parameter is used to build a file path without sanitization.

name: Server-Side Template Injection
detail: A template expression (1338*1337) was evaluated by the server to 1788906, indicating server-side template injection.

name: OS Command Injection
detail: Output of an injected OS command (id / arithmetic echo) appeared in the response, indicating command injection.

name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
detail: An injected HTML/script payload was reflected in the response without encoding, allowing cross-site scripting.

name: Open Redirect
detail: The parameter controls a redirect target and accepted an external URL, allowing an open redirect.

name: Blind SSRF / External Service Interaction
detail: The server made an out-of-band request to Interlace's tracking URL after the parameter was set to it, indicating server-side request forgery or external service interaction.
